gaps.explanation: detail[] has no business-type lines. Trimmed p6 (Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Net Position - Accrual Basis - Proprietary Funds) prints Water Fund, Sewer Fund and Golf Fund columns. JSON business receipts 1,047,477 = total operating revenues collected 1,041,960 + interest income 5,517 (Totals column). Added per fund: Water 434,694 + 4,821 = 439,515; Sewer 295,205 + 46,071 + 678 = 341,954; Golf 264,306 + 1,684 + 18 = 266,008. Sum 439,515 + 341,954 + 266,008 = 1,047,477 = statement total (gap 0). (The governmental revenue gap 47,205 was explained in pass 1 and is not repeated here.)
